what: The page-zoom escape control that PR #63 actually shipped (client/src/pages/LivingMap.tsx)
why: It only renders above a visualViewport scale of 1.05. Its own source records that four pinch-reset techniques were measured against a real synthesized pinch and none works on this engine. Playwright/WebKit on Windows offers no working pinch synthesis, so the zoom could not be raised and the control could not be made to appear. Neither passed nor failed.
env(safe-area-inset-*) reads 0 on WebKit for Windows. That is the platform reporting nothing, not the product having nothing. Counted, never treated as a pass.
